title: Frank & Atticus – Apple & Rhubarb Macaron 100ml
description:
Frank & Atticus – Apple & Rhubarb Macaron 100ml
Frank & Atticus’ Apple & Rhubarb Macaron is the right balance of sweet and tart.
Fresh apples and sugary sour rhubarb on the inhale and delicious creamy vanilla custard and almond meringue fusion on the exhale create a smooth finish with a silky texture in this vape juice.
Frank & Atticus vape juices come in 100ml bottles with 0MG nicotine. If you love dessert e-liquids, the Frank & Atticus juice range is a must-try!
